verified_facts.text: Fairmont Riyadh is in the Business Gate area of Riyadh, about 15 minutes from King Khalid Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated in the dynamic Business Gate area, Fairmont Riyadh is a luxury hotel located just 15 minutes away from King Khalid Airport

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near the Riyadh Front Complex.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our prime location near the Riyadh Front Complex makes the hotel perfect for both business and leisure travelers.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Riyadh skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience captivating views of Riyadh’s skyline through the floor-to-ceiling windows of our elegantly appointed rooms and suites.

verified_facts.text: Standard rooms have Le Labo bath amenities and a rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contemporary Design, Enhanced In-Room Technology Features, Sealy Bed Sleep Experience, Rain Shower, Exquisite Le Labo Amenities, 40 m² / 430 ft².

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has Art Deco furnishings and butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contemporary Elegant Art Deco Furnishings, Ultimate Urban Chic, 2 Bedrooms, Living/Dining Room, Kitchen, Office, Gold Lounge Access, Butler Service

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience with private lounge access and a dedicated concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upgrade to Fairmont Gold for an exclusive hotel-within-a-hotel experience

verified_facts.text: House of Grill Riyadh serves dishes in an Art Deco setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy exquisite dishes in an opulent Art Deco setting, offering a unique blend of vintage glamour and modern culinary excellence in Riyadh by Michelin-starred Chef Nicolas Isnard.

verified_facts.text: Plaza Café is a lobby lounge serving international beverages and desserts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plaza Café offers an elegant and sophisticated lobby lounge experience with a wide range of international beverages and dessert selections

verified_facts.text: Café Connect offers alfresco dining and light meals throughout the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Café Connect offers a modern, sunlit atmosphere with alfresco dining. Enjoy light meals served throughout the day

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Spa has separate facilities for men and women.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Spa offers a blissful sanctuary with separate facilities for men and women

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool open during scheduled hours for men and women.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Riyadh features a beautiful indoor swimming pool where guests can relax and unwind. Please note that the pool is open during scheduled hours for men and women.

verified_facts.text: Self-parking and valet parking are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both self-parking and valet services are available

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the airport and the Riyadh Exhibition Center, and hosts conferences and board meetings.
verified_facts.excerpt: is close to the airport and Riyadh Exhibition Center, making it the ideal location for international conferences, high-powered board meetings

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Fairmont Riyadh includes a state-of-the-art gym and fitness center
